name: Fuzzy Set-Based Volume Selection and Intersection
definition: A method to define three volume sets (Selection S, Ghost G, Background B) using selection functions fV and transformation T, and opacity transfer functions to create membership functions for fuzzy set operations, allowing control over intersections.
summary: Fuzzy Set-Based Volume Selection and Intersection uses fuzzy arithmetic to define distinct selection, ghost, and background sets, isolating intersection regions for custom blending to keep transformed objects visually distinct from their context.
